reauth_user_code.description:
Tuya 集成现在使用改进的登录方法。要使用您的 Smart Life 或 Tuya Smart 账户重新进行身份验证，您需要输入您的用户代码。

您可以在 Smart Life 应用程序或 Tyya Smart 应用程序的”设置“>”账户和安全“屏幕中找到此代码，输入”用户代码“字段显示的代码即可。用户代码区分大小写，输入时请务必与应用程序中显示的代码完全一致。

scan.description:
使用 Smart Life 应用程序或 Tuya Smart 应用程序扫描以下二维码完成登录。

在应用程序中完成此步骤后，继续下一步。

user.description:
输入您的 Smart Life 或 Tuya Smart 用户代码。 

您可以在 Smart Lift 应用或 Tuya Smart 应用中，Settings（设置）> Account and Security（账户和安全）屏幕上找到此代码，在“用户代码”字段中输入此代码。用户代码区分大小写，请务必准确输入，与应用中显示的代码一致。

tuya_iot_failed_request.title: Tuya OpenAPI request failed
tuya_iot_failed_request.description:
The integration "{name}" (`{config_entry_id}`) could not connect to the Tuya OpenAPI service (request failed)

To fix this error, check that your HA can access the internet and that there is no firewall in between HA and Tuya OpenAPI endpoints.

tuya_iot_failed_login.title: Tuya OpenAPI credentials expired
tuya_iot_failed_login.description:
The integration "{name}" (`{config_entry_id}`) could not connect to the Tuya OpenAPI service (credentials expired)

To fix this error please follow the guide at the URL by clicking the button below, then restart Home Assistant.

tuya_iot_not_configured.title: Tuya OpenAPI account not configured
tuya_iot_not_configured.description:
The integration "{name}" (`{config_entry_id}`) Does not have Tuya OpenAPI credentials

Without this, a lot of entities might be missing in your devices.

To fix this warning please follow the guide at the URL by clicking the button below, then restart Home Assistant.

tuya_iot_lock_not_subscribed.title: Tuya OpenAPI account badly configured (lock)
tuya_iot_lock_not_subscribed.description:
The integration "{name}" (`{config_entry_id}`) Does not have a Tuya OpenAPI account that is subscribed to the Smart Lock Open Service

Without this, locks will not function properly.

To fix this warning please follow the guide at the URL by clicking the button below, then restart Home Assistant.

tuya_iot_camera_not_subscribed.title: Tuya OpenAPI account badly configured (camera)
tuya_iot_camera_not_subscribed.description:
The integration "{name}" (`{config_entry_id}`) Does not have a Tuya OpenAPI account that is subscribed to the IoT Video Live Stream service

Without this, cameras will not function properly.

To fix this warning please follow the guide at the URL by clicking the button below, then restart Home Assistant.

tuya_iot_ir_not_subscribed.title: Tuya OpenAPI account badly configured (IR)
tuya_iot_ir_not_subscribed.description:
The integration "{name}" (`{config_entry_id}`) Does not have a Tuya OpenAPI account that is subscribed to the IR Control Hub Open Service service

Without this, IR devices will not function properly.

To fix this warning please follow the guide at the URL by clicking the button below, then restart Home Assistant.

tuya_iot_sensor_energy_stat_not_subscrib.title: Tuya OpenAPI account badly configured (Energy stat)
tuya_iot_sensor_energy_stat_not_subscrib.description:
The integration "{name}" (`{config_entry_id}`) Does not have a Tuya OpenAPI account that is subscribed to the Beta API service

Without this, fetching energy sensor consumption history will not function properly.

To fix this warning please follow the guide at the URL by clicking the button below, then restart Home Assistant.

tuya_iot_mqtt_failed_login.title: Tuya OpenAPI MQTT Not authorized
tuya_iot_mqtt_failed_login.description:
The integration "{name}" (`{config_entry_id}`) could not connect to the Tuya OpenAPI MQTT queue, something is wrong in your configuration

To fix this error please follow the guide at the URL by clicking the button below, then restart Home Assistant.
